summary: Formbricks is an open-source experience management suite designed to help you collect and manage customer surveys. It allows you to gather structured feedback across various stages of the user journey.
goodFor: It is well-suited for product and development teams looking to self-host their own survey infrastructure using open-source tools.
watchOut: The software is licensed under the AGPL-3.0, which carries strict copyleft compliance obligations if you modify the code and provide it as a network service.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, it typically requires a persistent volume for data storage, an external database, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
